title: Community College Courses
transcript:
Speaker 1: WOMAN：Welcome to Houston Community College, how can I help you?
Speaker 2: MAN：I’m thinking of signing up for a course. I have some free time these days and would like to try something different. What courses are available?
Speaker 1: WOMAN：We have a few available at the moment. Is there any particular day that suits you best?
Speaker 2: MAN：Any day is good except for Thursday.
Speaker 1: WOMAN：Ok, we have lots of courses on the other days. For example, we have our Skating class on Tuesday.
Speaker 2: MAN：That sounds interesting. I’ve never skated before. Are there any courses for novices?
Speaker 1: WOMAN：Sure, actually this course mainly includes basic skills and our professional coaches will teach you.
Speaker 2: MAN：That’s great. When does it begin?
Speaker 1: WOMAN：It used to begin at 8pm, but since it’s very popular, now it starts at 7. 45 pm and goes until quite late in the evening. It is a lot of fun.
Speaker 2: MAN：Those times work perfectly for me. How much does it cost then?
Speaker 1: WOMAN：It’s 650 dollars.
Speaker 2: MAN：Oh. I see.
. .
Speaker 2: That’s going to be quite expensive for me. I mean, I’m going to have to buy the equipment too.
Speaker 1: WOMAN：You don’t need to buy any equipment. The skates are included in the price.
Speaker 2: MAN：Oh. Ok, maybe that’s not so bad then.
Speaker 1: WOMAN：But you will need to wear warm clothes since it can be very cold late at night. It would be good to have something to keep you warm.
